value.body: The Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is a deemed-to-be university for journalism and communication. It runs one-year PG Diplomas in journalism (English and Hindi), radio & TV journalism, and advertising & PR, and since 2024 also MA programmes. Campuses are in New Delhi, Dhenkanal, Aizawl, Amravati, Kottayam and Jammu.

items.label: Campuses
items.note: New Delhi, Dhenkanal, Aizawl, Amravati, Kottayam, Jammu

items.label: Admission basis
items.note: Mass Communication & Journalism paper; IIMC e-counselling

items.label: PG Diploma age limit
items.note: 28 OBC; 30 SC/ST/PwD; no age limit for MA

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree in any discipline (at least 55% for MA programmes), a valid CUET-PG score in Mass Communication and Journalism, and registration on IIMC's e-counselling portal. Final-year students can apply provisionally.

value.title: At a glance
items: Seats per programme are small, so the CUET-PG score decides admission.
Programmes and their campuses change between years; the current admission notice lists what is offered.
Outcomes include reporting, editing, broadcast, advertising, PR and corporate communication roles; placements depend on the media job market each year.
